response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), status_shares AS (SELECT healtheval, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM status_shares) SELECT AVG(ss.record_count) AS average_count, AVG(ss.share) AS average_share, AVG(ss.share - a.value) AS average_excess_share FROM status_shares AS ss CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE ss.share > a.value;
